iti53:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ.
iti53:2.3: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
iti53:2.7: yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā hoti, dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭhā hoti,
iti53:2.8: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo sammaddaso acchecchi taṇhaṃ vāvattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā’ti.
iti53:5.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
